description: A foil pouch in a colour the others don't come in, a deep and slightly iridescent bronze, with no cartoon on it and no exclamation marks. MANY HAPPY RETURNS is printed small and centred, and under it, smaller still: ISSUED ONCE ANNUALLY PER REGISTERED INSTANCE. The straw is the good kind, the rigid kind, and it has been taped on straight.
name: soylent pouch (many happy returns)

tags.use_message: It is cold, and it is good, and it tastes of nothing you can name and everything you can almost remember. Somewhere behind it there is butter, and somewhere behind that there is a room with people in it. You get to the bottom of the pouch and the straw pulls air and you sit there for a moment holding an empty piece of foil, on the anniversary of the day somebody wrote your name down for the first time, feeling unaccountably fine about all of it.
